summary: Mon Territoire BIONIC™ page testing completed successfully. All 10 features tested and working: page loads correctly, three tabs functional (Carte BIONIC™, Waypoints actifs, Lieux enregistrés), hexagonal zones displayed with adaptive zoom behavior (zoom 10→60 zones, zoom 12→100 zones, zoom 15→150 zones), zoom/zones indicators visible, waypoint activation/deactivation working, places list with legend visible, layers panel functional, weather banner displayed, and waypoint targeting feature operational.
critical_code_review_comments: Adaptive zone system working correctly - zones scale with zoom level as expected
generateAdaptiveBionicZones function properly generates hexagonal zones based on zoom
ZoomHandler component correctly tracks zoom changes and updates zones in real-time
Waypoint targeting feature allows centering zones around a specific waypoint
Weather data integration working (temperature, wind, hunting score displayed)
localStorage used for waypoints and places - MOCKED (no backend persistence)
seed_data_creation: Default waypoints and places loaded from localStorage (3 waypoints, 2 places)
